==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Known as "Lord Ren" in Vietnam.
* He is also jokingly referred to as "FNC Ren" by Vietnamese fans due to his lackluster performance with his {{ci|Gragas}} against [[Fnatic]] in a [[Worlds 2017 Play-In]] Groups match.
* He is known for his catchphrase "Người Việt Nam không có dở" which means "Vietnamese players are not weak".
